name: What are the advantages of buying an off-market waterfront home?

mainEntity.name: What are the advantages of buying an off-market waterfront home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Buying an off-market waterfront home can offer several advantages, primarily access to exclusive inventory not available to the general public. This can mean less competition from other buyers, potentially leading to a more favorable negotiation. It also provides the opportunity to secure a unique property that perfectly matches specific desires for location, size, or amenities in sought-after areas such as Fisher Island or Las Olas. The process can also be more private and streamlined.
acceptedAnswer.description: Advantages include access to exclusive inventory, less competition, and the chance to secure a unique property. The process can also be more private.
